notes.name: Medication list
notes.body: enalapril in the morning, atorvastatin at night, aspirin 100 after lunch, Susi takes levothyroxine fasting

notes.name: Blood pressure log August
notes.body: 130 over 80 on the 3rd, 125 over 78 on the 10th, 140 over 85 on the 17th after the stairs, 128 over 80 today

notes.name: Dr Navarro advice March
notes.body: less salt, walk thirty minutes a day, bring the log next time, stress test in September if the pressure stays up

notes.name: Bloodwork results June
notes.body: cholesterol 190, sugar 98, creatinine fine, Dra Pinto says same dose of atorvastatin

notes.name: Knee exercises from Lucas
notes.body: leg raises twenty times, wall sits for a minute, the bike ten minutes, no stairs when it clicks

notes.name: Repertorio del concierto de primavera
notes.body: Fauré Requiem Introit and Kyrie, Ave Verum Corpus, two Argentine folk songs arranged by Maestra Laura

notes.name: Fauré Requiem bass notes
notes.body: watch the entry at the Sanctus, breathe before the long phrase in the Libera me, ask Hugo for the page numbers

notes.name: Rehearsal notes 19 Aug
notes.body: tenors rushed the Kyrie, basses need the low D, Laura wants everyone in black, extra rehearsals in September

notes.name: Coro dues and rules
notes.body: dues 8000 a month to Marta, folders back on the shelf, no phones in the pews, coffee fund voluntary

notes.name: Car details
notes.body: Fiat Siena 2009, GNC fourth generation, 32 psi front and rear, spare tyre under the boot floor

notes.name: Car services

notes.name: VTV and oblea dates

notes.name: Milanesas de Susi
notes.body: thin beef round, egg and garlic and parsley, breadcrumbs twice, shallow fry, lemon at the table

notes.name: Locro del 25 de mayo
notes.body: white corn soaked overnight, beans, pumpkin, chorizo colorado, panceta, cook five hours, sauce on the side

notes.name: Empanadas tucumanas
notes.body: hand-cut beef, spring onion, cumin, hard-boiled egg, bake hot, repulgue with the double fold

notes.name: Ñoquis del 29
notes.body: potatoes baked not boiled, flour little by little, a coin under the plate for luck

notes.name: Madrid 2025 - what to bring

notes.name: Córdoba trip plan

notes.name: Diary entry - difficult week
notes.body: Susi's knee, three phone calls with PAMI, the lift was out twice, nobody picked up at the clinic

notes.name: Diary entry - lovely Sunday
